name: Syns
description: Per-turn auto-pull and auto-push of a Syns repository, scoped to directories containing a .syns.yaml.

pushMessage.description: Commit message used by `syns push`. Overrides the SYNS_PUSH_MESSAGE env var.

installIfMissing.description: Install the syns CLI via install.syns.dev on first use if it is not on PATH.

pullOnTurnStart.description: Run `syns pull --if-repo` at the start of every agent turn (before_agent_run).

pushOnTurnEnd.description: Run `syns push --if-repo` at the end of every agent turn (agent_end).

cwd.description: Working directory to run syns in — the Syns repo path. Highest-priority cwd source; survives gateway restart (unlike the SYNS_CWD env var). Default: auto-detected.

synsBin.description: Path to the syns binary. Use an absolute path if syns is not on the gateway daemon's PATH.

debug.description: Log resolved cwd and every syns invocation to stderr (gateway log).
